lines.en: St. George's summer is cursed, oh dear,
Gjurgjica was picking flowers, oh dear,
she decorated her mother's apron with them.
She decorated her mother's apron, oh dear,

lines.cyr: мајка ги од скут, мори, фрлаше.
lines.lat: majka gi od skut, mori, frlaše.
lines.en: her mother threw them out of her lap, hey.

lines.cyr: Нит' Ѓурѓа моја, нит' цвеќе, леле,
lines.lat: Nit' Ǵurǵa moja, nit' cveḱe, lele,
lines.en: Neither my Gjurga, nor flowers, oh dear,

lines.cyr: кога си мајка, мори, не слуша.
lines.lat: koga si majka, mori, ne sluša.
lines.en: when you are a mother, hey, she doesn't listen.
go up to the sheep dairy.
Go up to the sheep dairy, Gjurgja,

lines.cyr: Не смеам, мајко, да одам, леле,
lines.lat: Ne smeam, majko, da odam, lele,
lines.en: I dare not go, mother, oh dear,
Petre the shepherd is there, mama,

lines.cyr: он мене ќе ме, мори, заљуби.
lines.lat: on mene ḱe me, mori, zaljubi.
lines.en: he will make me fall in love with him, hey.
